Findings (each reproduced twice from scratch)
1. MEDIUM Journal page has no way to retry after the entries fail to load
   where: /journal (GET /api/journal)
   expected: After a failed load, the error has a Retry / Try again control so the feed can be reloaded once the server recovers
   saw: ["Sign out"]

2. MEDIUM Plant detail journal shows a load error with no way to retry
   where: /plants/:id Journal section (GET /api/journal?plant_id=...)
   expected: A Retry control next to the 'could not load the journal' error
   saw: ["Add entry"]
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-180125-hunt-2f55/probes/journal-faults-csr.mjs (expectation "detail-journal-retry-available")
3. MEDIUM Malformed journal response is rendered as a list of blank entries instead of an error
